hypothesis: A 20-bar Donchian close breakout aligned with a deterministic EMA50 trend state may have positive net expectancy after conservative execution costs and actual historical funding; test separately in BULL and BEAR contexts.

rules.signal: At completed 4h close t, close > max(high[t-20..t-1]) for long or close < min(low[t-20..t-1]) for short.
rules.context: BULL when close[t] > EMA50[t] and EMA50[t] > EMA50[t-10]; BEAR when close[t] < EMA50[t] and EMA50[t] < EMA50[t-10]; otherwise TRANSITION.
rules.stop: 1.5 x Wilder ATR(14) from adjusted entry fill.
rules.intrabar_collision: If stop and target are both touched in one 4h bar, assume stop first.
rules.position_policy: One position at a time per symbol; ignore signals while a position is open; skip entries too close to split end to complete horizon.
rules.sizing: 1% of segment equity risk per trade; maximum 3x notional leverage; initial segment equity 10,000 USDT.

costs.history_spread: Unavailable; 2 bps per side is a conservative proxy.
costs.fee_tier: Account-specific tier unavailable; 5 bps taker per side assumed.

funding.fallback: Use last completed 4h close strictly before fundingTime when markPrice is blank.
funding.event_timing: Apply funding events from entryTime through the open time of the exit bar, inclusive; conservative for unknown intrabar exit time.

baselines: Donchian breakout without EMA trend filter
limitations: Historical lot-step/tick-size rounding not applied because current exchangeInfo is stale.
No explicit network latency model; entry is next 4h open.
Current exchangeInfo metadata is stale and cannot validate current contract status.
